events.description: Two individuals are engaged in mutual physical combat in the crosswalk, with one person on the ground and another standing over them while others intervene.
A person appears to be striking or restraining a fallen individual on the ground in the crosswalk while others observe or approach; the victim is not actively resisting.

Multiple individuals are running across the street, some appear to be throwing objects (debris visible on road), and police are actively moving to contain or disperse the group; this constitutes collective violent unrest beyond peaceful protest.

A person in dark clothing is lying on the street while multiple police officers surround and physically engage with them; one officer appears to be applying force or restraining the individual, who remains prone throughout the sequence.

At the start of the sequence, a person in black appears to be actively engaging with officers (e.g., raising arms, moving toward them), and an officer in high-visibility vest is seen moving aggressively toward the prone individual, suggesting initial physical confrontation before full restraint.
A person in dark clothing is on the ground while multiple officers, including one in a yellow vest, are actively restraining them; the individual appears helpless and non-resisting.

A man in a black hooded jacket confronts and physically engages with an officer in a yellow 'Metropolitan Police' vest; they exchange shoves and grabs, with the officer extending arms to push or block.

A person remains prone and motionless on the street (center of intersection) throughout this period while officers stand around; no active restraint is visible after ~21.5s, but the individual remains unassisted and exposed in a high-traffic area, suggesting ongoing neglect or post-restraint vulnerability.

A police officer in a high-visibility vest is seen actively pushing or shoving a person in dark clothing who is standing and facing the officer; the person appears to be resisting or being forced backward. The interaction involves direct physical force applied by the officer to a non-falling individual.

A person in full black attire (including hood, jacket, pants, gloves) lies motionless on the street pavement in a prone position with arms outstretched, while multiple officers stand around them without rendering aid or initiating arrest procedures. The person remains immobile across all frames, suggesting they are incapacitated or being ignored despite proximity of officers.

Large group of uniformed police officers (dozens visible) deployed in an urban intersection, forming lines, confronting individuals, and surrounding a person on the ground; presence of bicycles, marked vehicles, and coordinated positioning indicates organized response to collective unrest, not a routine traffic stop or minor incident.

A person in dark clothing lies motionless on the street while multiple police officers stand around them; one officer appears to have just moved away from the person (f0–f1), and the person remains prone throughout the sequence with no visible movement or assistance, suggesting they are helpless and possibly injured or incapacitated.

Large group of police officers in riot gear deployed in an urban intersection, with multiple individuals on the ground, bicycles scattered, and tense standoff dynamics; consistent with collective violent unrest or violent group clash context.

Two individuals are lying motionless on the street in a crosswalk while multiple police officers stand nearby; one officer appears to be holding or pointing a weapon toward them, and smoke (possibly from a less-lethal munition) is visible near the scene. The individuals show no signs of movement or resistance, suggesting they are helpless victims of force.

A large group of police officers in riot gear confronts a crowd of civilians on a city street; there is visible tension, deployment of smoke/tear gas, and individuals on the ground, indicating collective violent unrest or violent group clash beyond peaceful protest.

Multiple police officers engage in physical confrontation with individuals in a crowd; officers are seen pushing, grabbing, and using batons against protesters, while some protesters resist or push back. The interaction involves mutual physical contact and struggle, consistent with fighting.

A large group of people (protesters) and multiple police officers are engaged in sustained, chaotic, and violent group clashes on a sidewalk, including shoving, baton use, and attempts to disperse or hold ground—meeting the definition of collective violent unrest.

A sustained violent confrontation between multiple police officers and a dense crowd of civilians on a city sidewalk, involving pushing, shoving, and attempts to breach or hold a line; officers in riot gear are actively engaging the crowd, some individuals appear to be resisting or being restrained, consistent with collective violent unrest.

A large group of civilians and police officers are engaged in a tense, dynamic confrontation on a city sidewalk and street. Officers in riot gear (helmets, vests, batons) are actively moving toward and engaging with the crowd; some officers are seen advancing, pushing, and forming lines while civilians appear to be resisting or retreating. The scene includes physical proximity, shoving, and coordinated police movement indicative of violent unrest or clashing groups, not a peaceful protest.
